content.text:
The last thing I did was implement the approved "structured logging" plan:

1. **`src/calc.py`** — added `import logging`, a module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` with a `NullHandler`, DEBUG entry/exit logs in `add`, `mul`, and `div` (lazy `%s` formatting plus an `extra` dict of fields), and an `ERROR` log on `div`'s zero-divisor path before it raises `ValueError`.
2. **`tests/test_calc.py`** — added `test_add_logs_debug` and `test_div_by_zero_logs_error` using `caplog`.
3. **`CLAUDE.md`** — extended the `src/calc.py` bullet to mention DEBUG logging and the `div` ERROR.

Then I verified: `9 passed in 0.06s`; an unconfigured import of `add(2, 3)` printed just `5` with no log noise; and with `basicConfig(level=DEBUG)` the `div(1, 0)` run emitted `DEBUG:src.calc:div(1, 0)` then `ERROR:src.calc:division by zero` before the traceback.

Nothing has been committed. Still open, if you want them: fixing `CLAUDE.md`'s stale `python -m pytest` command (needs `.venv/bin/python` here) and committing the changes.
